details.further_information: HSV received 20 % of the transfer profit from LOSC Lille on the transfer to Everton FC. The transfer fee increased by €5,600,000 to €12,600,000. Lille also received 20 % of the transfer profit from Everton on the transfer to Aston Villa. The transfer fee increased from €35,000,000 to €39,870,000. HSV again benefited from this with 20 percent.
